rationale: STRL is caught between conflicting timeframes: it has sold off heavily on 5.38x relative volume and remains well below session VWAP ($296.95), yet it is currently bouncing above its 5-minute 9-EMA ($287.36) with five consecutive bullish 1-minute candles. Furthermore, the 20.6 bps spread ($0.60 wide) introduces substantial slippage relative to the ~6 points of upside to VWAP and ~3.4 points of downside to the 9-EMA, leaving neither direction with an asymmetric risk-reward profile right now.
